extract: Meta Platforms on Monday launched public offerings of about US$35 billion in common stock and convertible preferred stock, as the Facebook parent seeks to finance its costly AI expansion.

The social media company also said it plans to launch a separate at-the-market share sale program of up to $60 billion after its new non-voting Class C shares begin trading, which is expected in the first quarter of 2027.
The fundraising plans come as Meta ramps up spending on data centers, computing capacity and AI products to compete with rival AI heavyweights OpenAI and Anthropic.
